titleEn: Run the reorder, low-stock and dead-stock scans now

undo.note: a scan only reads and raises suggestions

ar: ازاي اعرف المخزون اللي محتاج طلب جديد؟
en: How do I run a stock scan now?

steps: Open Stock, press Scan now / Re-scan now
edgeCases: One run per scan per store per hour (429 after that); platform staff are not limited
Scans never send messages to customers

readOnlyPost.reason: A scan only reads orders and stock and derives its own reorder, low-stock or dead-stock suggestion rows. It never changes the catalogue, a price, a stock level or sends a message to a customer.
